scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @student/api" "npm run dev -w @student/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @student/api && npm run build -w @student/web
scripts.check: npm run check -w @student/api && npm run check -w @student/web
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run build -w @student/api && npm run openapi:export -w @student/api && npm run api:generate -w @student/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @student/api && node apps/api/test/integration.mjs && node apps/api/test/workflow.mjs
